checks.title: HTTPS & SSL Encryption

checks.details: HTTP automatically redirects to HTTPS via 301 Permanent Redirect.

checks.description: Ensures the server responds with a healthy 200 OK status without excessive redirect chains.
checks.details: First byte response time is well within Core Web Vitals thresholds (< 200ms).

checks.details: No unintended Disallow rules blocking major search engine user-agents.

checks.title: Canonical Link Tag

checks.details: Page renders seamlessly across mobile screen sizes with touch targets >= 48px.

checks.title: Page Title Tag
checks.description: Checks length, clarity, and primary keyword placement in the HTML title.
checks.value: Example Domain - High Performance Web Application (54 chars)

checks.title: Meta Description Tag
checks.description: Evaluates description presence, length, and enticing click-through messaging.
checks.details: The current meta description is only 34 characters long, which is too brief to convey value.
checks.recommendation: Expand the description to 140-155 characters highlighting primary user benefits and a clear call-to-action.

aiInsight.overview: Your website maintains a solid technical foundation with fast response times (84ms TTFB) and explicit Schema JSON-LD. Enhancing meta description length and formatting key subheadings with direct 1-sentence answers will maximize both search click-throughs and Answer Engine snippet selection.
strengths: Fast TTFB (84ms) and clean HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect architecture.
Strict semantic heading hierarchy with no skipped levels.
Organization and WebSite JSON-LD schemas anchor brand entities.
topPriorities: Expand homepage meta description from 34 to ~150 characters to improve search click-through rates.
Add contextual alt text to the 3 hero & thumbnail image elements.
Format H2 question answers with concise, standalone summary sentences.

recommendations.title: Improve the meta description
recommendations.findingSummary: The current meta description is only 34 characters long, wasting search snippet real estate.
recommendations.whyItMatters: No dedicated or complete meta description was detected. Google will frequently generate an unpredictable snippet from arbitrary body text.
recommendations.actionableFix: Add a concise description summarizing the page's primary purpose and core user proposition.
recommendations.suggestedCopy: Analyze your website's technical SEO, content structure, answer-engine readiness, and AI discoverability signals with Rankly.

recommendations.title: Add descriptive alternative text to 3 images
recommendations.findingSummary: The hero graphic and two showcase thumbnails are rendered without alt attributes.
recommendations.whyItMatters: Search engine bots and multimodal AI vision models cannot index visual context without alternative text labels.
recommendations.actionableFix: Audit the tags and provide descriptive labels explaining what each graphic illustrates.
recommendations.codeExample:
<Image
  src="/images/hero-flow.png"
  alt="Rankly search, answer, and generative engine intelligence dashboard"
  width={800}
  height={500}
/>

recommendations.title: Structure direct 1-sentence answer blocks
recommendations.findingSummary: Answers to user questions are embedded deep within multi-paragraph sections.
recommendations.whyItMatters: Answer engines (Google AI Overviews, Perplexity) prioritize concise, standalone 40-60 word answer paragraphs directly following question headings.
recommendations.actionableFix: Lead each FAQ or question section with a definitive thesis statement before delving into supporting details.
